degree_required.quote: having received a diploma from some reputable medical college or osteopathic college that enforces requirements of four terms of thirty-two weeks for actual instruction in each term

accrediting_body.quote: Any medical college approved and accredited as reputable by the American Medical Association or the Liaison Committee on Medical Education and any osteopathic college approved and accredited as reputable by the American Osteopathic Association is deemed to have complied with the requirements of this subsection.

degree_level.quote: having received a diploma from some reputable medical college or osteopathic college that enforces requirements of four terms of thirty-two weeks for actual instruction in each term

school_approval_basis.quote: Any medical college approved and accredited as reputable by the American Medical Association or the Liaison Committee on Medical Education and any osteopathic college approved and accredited as reputable by the American Osteopathic Association

credential_pegged.quote: having received a diploma from some reputable medical college or osteopathic college

required.quote: every applicant for a permanent license as a physician and surgeon shall provide the board with satisfactory evidence of having successfully completed such postgraduate training in hospitals or medical or osteopathic colleges as the board may prescribe by rule.

experience_source.quote: every applicant for a permanent license as a physician and surgeon shall provide the board with satisfactory evidence of having successfully completed such postgraduate training in hospitals or medical or osteopathic colleges as the board may prescribe by rule.

kind.value: postgraduate training in hospitals or medical or osteopathic colleges
kind.quote: postgraduate training in hospitals or medical or osteopathic colleges as the board may prescribe by rule

exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE)
exams.notes: Applicants graduating on or after January 1, 1994 must provide proof of successful completion of USMLE or COMLEX. Steps 1, 2, and 3 must be taken within a seven-year period with no more than three attempts on any step.
exams.quote: the board may require applicants to take the Federation Licensing Examination, also known as FLEX, or the United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE)

exams.name: National Board of Osteopathic Medical Examiners Comprehensive Licensing Exam (COMLEX)
exams.notes: Alternative to USMLE for osteopathic graduates. Steps must be taken within a seven-year period with no more than three attempts on any step.
exams.quote: Applicants graduating from a medical or osteopathic college, as described in section 334.031 on or after January 1, 1994, must provide proof of successful completion of the USMLE or the COMLEX

exams.name: Federation Licensing Examination (FLEX)
exams.notes: Alternative exam accepted for graduates before January 1, 1994; a weighted average score of no less than seventy-five is required to pass.
exams.quote: Applicants graduating from a medical or osteopathic college, as described in section 334.031 prior to January 1, 1994, shall provide proof of successful completion of the FLEX

required.quote: The board shall not renew any certificate of registration unless the licensee shall provide satisfactory evidence that he has complied with the board's minimum requirements for continuing education.

hours_per_period.quote: the state board of registration for the healing arts shall accept toward the fifty-hour license renewal requirement, continuing medical education courses

topical_requirements.quote: the state board of registration for the healing arts shall accept toward the fifty-hour license renewal requirement, continuing medical education courses which have an emphasis on the early diagnosis and treatment of autism in children.

available.quote: Any person who holds a valid current physician and surgeon license issued by another state, a branch or unit of the military, a territory of the United States, or the District of Columbia, and who has been licensed for at least one year in such other jurisdiction, may submit to the board an application for a physician and surgeon license in Missouri

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a valid current license in another state/territory/military/DC for at least one year, have met minimum education requirements in that jurisdiction, not have had license revoked, no pending complaints or disciplinary actions, license in good standing, no disqualifying criminal record, and pay applicable fees.
requirements.quote: the board shall waive any examination, educational, or experience requirements for licensure in this state for the applicant if it determines that there were minimum education requirements and, if applicable, work experience and clinical supervision requirements in effect and the other jurisdiction verifies that the person met those requirements

approximate.matched_normalized: waive any examination educational or experience requirements for licensure in this state for the applicant if it determines that there were minimum education requirements and if applicable work experience and clinical supervision requirements in effect and the other jurisdiction verifies that the person met those requirements

exists.quote: the state board of registration for the healing arts

national_certification.value: National Board of Medical Examiners / National Board of Examiners for Osteopathic Physicians and Surgeons
national_certification.quote: the board, by rule and regulation, may accept the certificate of the National Board of Medical Examiners of the United States, chartered pursuant to the laws of the District of Columbia, of the National Board of Examiners for Osteopathic Physicians and Surgeons chartered pursuant to the laws of the state of Indiana, or of the Licentiate of the Medical Counsel of Canada (LMCC) in lieu of and as equivalent to its own professional examination.

national_association.value: American Medical Association / American Osteopathic Association
national_association.quote: Any medical college approved and accredited as reputable by the American Medical Association or the Liaison Committee on Medical Education and any osteopathic college approved and accredited as reputable by the American Osteopathic Association

is_mandatory.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person not now a registered physician within the meaning of the law to practice medicine or surgery in any of its departments

title_protection.quote: Where other statutes of this state use the terms "physician", "surgeon", "practitioner of medicine" ... they shall be construed to mean physicians and surgeons licensed under this chapter

scope_protection.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person not now a registered physician within the meaning of the law to practice medicine or surgery in any of its departments

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of any controlled substance or alcoholic beverage to an extent that impairs ability to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of any controlled substance, as defined in chapter 195, or alcoholic beverage to an extent that such use impairs a person's ability to perform the work of any profession licensed or regulated by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Final adjudication or plea of guilty or nolo contendere in a criminal prosecution for an offense reasonably related to the profession, involving fraud, dishonesty, violence, or moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The person has been finally adjudicated and found guilty, or entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere, in a criminal prosecution under the laws of any state or of the United States, for any offense reasonably related to the qualifications, functions or duties of any profession licensed or regulated pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of fraud, deception, misrepresentation or bribery in securing any certificate, permit or license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of fraud, deception, misrepresentation or bribery in securing any certificate of registration or authority, permit or license issued pursuant to this chapter or in obtaining permission to take any examination given or required pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misconduct, fraud, misrepresentation, dishonesty, unethical or unprofessional conduct in the performance of professional duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misconduct, fraud, misrepresentation, dishonesty, unethical conduct or unprofessional conduct in the performance of the functions or duties of any profession licensed or regulated by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any conduct or practice which is harmful or dangerous to patient or public health, or incompetency, gross negligence or repeated negligence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any conduct or practice which is or might be harmful or dangerous to the mental or physical health of a patient or the public; or incompetency, gross negligence or repeated negligence in the performance of the functions or duties of any profession licensed or regulated by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of, or attempting to violate, any provision of chapter 334 or chapter 324 or any lawful rule adopted thereunder
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of, or attempting to violate, directly or indirectly, or assisting or enabling any person to violate, any provision of this chapter or chapter 324, or of any lawful rule or regulation adopted pursuant to this chapter or chapter 324

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impersonating any licensee or allowing another to use one's certificate, permit, license or diploma
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impersonation of any person holding a certificate of registration or authority, permit or license or allowing any person to use his or her certificate of registration or authority, permit, license or diploma from any school

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension, restriction or other final disciplinary action by another state, territory, federal agency or country
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revocation, suspension, restriction, modification, limitation, reprimand, warning, censure, probation or other final disciplinary action against the holder of or applicant for a license or other right to practice any profession regulated by this chapter by another state, territory, federal agency or country

disciplinary_grounds.description: Final adjudication of incapacity or disability by a court
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A person is finally adjudged incapacitated or disabled by a court of competent jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Assisting or enabling any person to practice who is not registered and currently eligible to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Assisting or enabling any person to practice or offer to practice any profession licensed or regulated by this chapter who is not registered and currently eligible to practice pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Issuance of a certificate or license based upon a material mistake of fact
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Issuance of a certificate of registration or authority, permit or license based upon a material mistake of fact

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to display a valid certificate or license as required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to display a valid certificate or license if so required by this chapter or any rule promulgated pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of state or federal drug laws or rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the drug laws or rules and regulations of this state, including but not limited to any provision of chapter 195, any other state, or the federal government

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly making a false statement in any birth, death or other certificate or document
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly making, or causing to be made, or aiding, or abetting in the making of, a false statement in any birth, death or other certificate or document executed in connection with the practice of the person's profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly making a false statement, orally or in writing to the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly making a false statement, orally or in writing to the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual intoxication or dependence on alcohol
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual intoxication or dependence on alcohol, evidence of which may include more than one alcohol-related enforcement contact as defined by section 302.525

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with a treatment or aftercare program entered into as part of a board order or settlement agreement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with a treatment program or an aftercare program entered into as part of a board order, settlement agreement or licensee's professional health program

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension or voluntary termination of controlled substance authority while under investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revocation, suspension, limitation, probation, or restriction of any kind whatsoever of any controlled substance authority, whether agreed to voluntarily or not, or voluntary termination of a controlled substance authority while under investigation

definition_quote.value: practice medicine or surgery in any of its departments, to engage in the practice of medicine across state lines or to profess to cure and attempt to treat the sick and others afflicted with bodily or mental infirmities, or engage in the practice of midwifery
definition_quote.quote: practice medicine or surgery in any of its departments, to engage in the practice of medicine across state lines or to profess to cure and attempt to treat the sick and others afflicted with bodily or mental infirmities, or engage in the practice of midwifery in this state

value: practice of medicine across state lines
methods_authorized.quote: practice medicine or surgery in any of its departments, to engage in the practice of medicine across state lines or to profess to cure and attempt to treat the sick and others afflicted with bodily or mental infirmities, or engage in the practice of midwifery in this state

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe, administer, or dispense controlled substances for therapeutic purposes including intractable pain treatment; prescribing subject to board rules and state/federal drug law compliance.
drug_authority.quote: a physician may prescribe, administer or dispense controlled substances for a therapeutic purpose to a person diagnosed and treated by a physician for a condition resulting in intractable pain

license_status_types.quote: any person licensed pursuant to this chapter may apply to the state board of registration for the healing arts for an inactive license status

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign trained graduates must meet the same educational requirements under 334.031; board may recognize credentials of physicians licensed in foreign countries for teaching temporary licenses; ECFMG or equivalent may be required for international graduates.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: the board may recognize and take into account the credentials of a physician licensed in other states or in foreign countries

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Schedule III narcotic controlled substances and Schedule II - hydrocodone prescriptions by assistant physicians and physician assistants limited to five-day supply without refill, except buprenorphine for MAT (up to 30-day supply). Physicians may prescribe controlled substances for therapeutic purposes for intractable pain without discipline solely for such prescribing.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: Schedule III controlled substances and Schedule II - hydrocodone prescriptions shall be limited to a five-day supply without refill, except that buprenorphine may be prescribed for up to a thirty-day supply without refill for patients receiving medication-assisted treatment for substance use disorders

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Prior to prescribing through telemedicine or the internet, a physician must establish a valid physician-patient relationship including obtaining a reliable medical history, performing a physical examination, having sufficient dialogue, and maintaining contemporaneous records. Prescribing based solely on telephone evaluation is prohibited unless a previously established ongoing physician-patient relationship exists.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: Prior to prescribing any drug, controlled substance, or other treatment through telemedicine, as defined in section 191.1145, or the internet, a physician shall establish a valid physician-patient relationship

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: In order to strengthen access to health care, and in recognition of the advances in the delivery of health care, the member states of the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact have allied in common purpose to develop a comprehensive process that complements the existing licensing and regulatory authority of state medical boards

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: No physician assistant shall practice or attempt to practice without physician collaboration or in any location where the collaborating physician is not immediately available for consultation, assistance and intervention

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Physician assistants may prescribe drugs, medicines, devices or therapies pursuant to a collaborative practice arrangement specific to the clinical conditions treated. May prescribe Schedule III, IV, V controlled substances and Schedule II - hydrocodone (5-day supply without refill; buprenorphine for MAT up to 30-day supply) when delegated authority in collaborative practice arrangement. Must register with DEA and state bureau of narcotics.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: A physician assistant with a certificate of controlled substance prescriptive authority as provided in this section may prescribe any controlled substance listed in Schedule III, IV, or V of section 195.017, and may have restricted authority in Schedule II, when delegated the authority to prescribe controlled substances in a collaborative practice arrangement.

max_physician_assistants_per_supervising.quote: No physician shall be designated to serve as a collaborating physician for more than six full-time equivalent licensed physician assistants, full-time equivalent advanced practice registered nurses, or full-time equivalent assistant physicians, or any combination thereof.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: After a contested hearing before the board, and upon a showing of reasonable cause to believe that a licensee or applicant is unable to practice his or her profession with reasonable skill and safety to the public by reason of medical or osteopathic incompetency, mental, or physical incapacity, or due to the excessive use or abuse of alcohol or controlled substances the board may require a licensee or applicant to submit to an examination.
